title: Exact Solution Comparison with Euler's Approximation
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For dy/dx = y with y(0) = 1, compare Euler's approximation y_n at x = 1 using n steps with the exact value e.

steps.title: Derive General Step Formula
steps.mathExpression: h = \frac{1}{n}, \quad y_{k+1} = y_k + h y_k = y_k(1 + h) = y_k\left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)
steps.explanation: Each step multiplies current value by (1 + 1/n).

steps.title: Take Limit as n -> oo
steps.explanation: Recovers the Euler definition of the natural base e.
